description: CI canary — runs without a real LLM. Tests framework infrastructure and scoring pipeline.

framework_checks.check: from devagent.tools.registry import build_registry; r = build_registry(); names = r.names(); assert 'read_file' in names and 'write_file' in names and 'run_shell' in names and 'grep' in names and 'git_status' in names, f'Missing tools: {names}'

framework_checks.description: Web tools register when searchx_base_url is set
framework_checks.check: from devagent.tools.registry import build_registry; r = build_registry(searchx_base_url='http://localhost:8888'); assert 'fetch_url' in r.names(), 'fetch_url missing'

framework_checks.description: Default config loads with correct provider
framework_checks.check: from devagent.core.config import DevAgentConfig; c = DevAgentConfig(); assert c.llm.provider == 'ollama'; assert c.search_provider in ('brave', 'searchx')

framework_checks.description: Vision tools register for vision providers
framework_checks.check: from devagent.tools.registry import build_registry; r = build_registry(provider='anthropic'); assert 'read_image' in r.names(), 'read_image missing for anthropic'

framework_checks.description: Todo tools register when session_id provided
framework_checks.check: from devagent.tools.registry import build_registry; r = build_registry(session_id='test-session-123'); assert 'todo_write' in r.names() and 'todo_read' in r.names()

from devagent.bench.oracle import OracleEvaluator; import tempfile; oe = OracleEvaluator(); d = tempfile.mkdtemp(); result = oe.evaluate('exit 0', cwd=d); assert result is True, f'expected True, got {result}'

from devagent.bench.oracle import OracleEvaluator; import tempfile; oe = OracleEvaluator(); d = tempfile.mkdtemp(); result = oe.evaluate('exit 1', cwd=d); assert result is False, f'expected False, got {result}'
from devagent.bench.runner import BenchRunner; tasks = BenchRunner.load_tasks(); assert len(tasks) >= 10, f'Expected >=10 tasks, got {len(tasks)}'
